best_practice_sources.name: AWS S3 Object Lock
best_practice_sources.takeaway: Object Lock uses WORM-style retention/legal holds and works only with S3 Versioning enabled; this slice requires versioning plus lock posture metadata but does not enable provider bucket settings.

best_practice_sources.name: AWS S3 object key naming
best_practice_sources.takeaway: S3 object keys are flat identifiers up to 1,024 bytes where prefixes/delimiters are naming conventions; this slice requires an explicit tenant/cell prefix and rejects relative/control-character patterns.

best_practice_sources.name: OCI Object Storage retention rules
best_practice_sources.takeaway: OCI retention rules are bucket-level controls that prevent object modification/deletion under governance or regulatory use cases; this slice records retention posture as metadata only.

best_practice_sources.name: OCI Block Volume backups
best_practice_sources.takeaway: OCI block volume backups are point-in-time backup/snapshot resources that can be policy-driven and restored later; this slice requires snapshot evidence refs but does not call OCI.

best_practice_sources.name: Kubernetes VolumeSnapshots
best_practice_sources.takeaway: Kubernetes VolumeSnapshot objects standardize point-in-time copies through CSI controllers; this slice models snapshot evidence metadata without deploying CSI resources.
